coreRoundtrip.scope: R3 first open through R5 first reopen and read-only MCP
uniqueFindings: Unicode and spaces in the parent path and project name were accepted on first open with zero project-directory disk changes.
First explicit save added 6 files and modified 9 with no deletions while preserving Unicode display names and relative references.
Desktop canonical output repeated the three-root-file public-schema gap observed in Run A.
First reopen was stable with zero disk changes; read-only MCP confirmed Model, PowerBI_V3, compatibility level 1606, and zero tables.

playbookOnlyFinalRoundtrip.scope: R6 extra close and reopen after core acceptance
playbookOnlyFinalRoundtrip.confidenceGain: Confirmed identical behavior and zero disk diff in a third independent Desktop/model process start under the Unicode-and-space path condition.
playbookOnlyFinalRoundtrip.duplicatedEvidence: Repeated R5 UI identity, page visibility, no-prompt behavior, and 15-file byte identity without new structural or semantic information.

runBEvaluation.recommendationRationale: After a successful core reopen plus MCP validation, the extra full roundtrip added repeatability confidence but found no new issue. Use a risk trigger or sampling rule for similarly minimal projects.

crossRunSignal.boundary: Record as V1 feedback only; do not modify Playbook v0.1 in this project.

measurementLimitations: Core human active time and machine-only time were not instrumented prospectively and remain null.
The extra human duration was reported qualitatively as a few seconds, so no fabricated numeric human minute value is recorded.
The 0.04 machineCheckMinutes value covers the manifest/process comparison command only; documentation and checkpoint work are separate.
Elapsed time from Desktop process start includes human interaction and response latency and must not be interpreted as machine-only cost.
Evidence byte totals exclude this metrics file itself to avoid a self-referential size calculation.
